job.purpose: el1011-hbm-dmafs two-level split of ot_hgi_dma_front: CORE tile (8 svc lanes + 8 SRAM FIFOs, X1 picks, R / id / tags / completion; registered seams to the 4 slice tiles)

benches.name: xs_front_exact
benches.cmd: set -o pipefail; mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && $HOME/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin/verilator --binary --timing -O2 -Wno-fatal -Wno-WIDTH -Wno-UNUSED -Wno-BLKSEQ -Wno-UNOPTFLAT -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-CASEINCOMPLETE --top-module tb_hgi_dma_front -GNL=2 -GXP=1 -GXQ=1 -GXS=1 -GMUT=0 -Mdir {RUN}/bench/obj0 rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/ot_hgi_dma_front.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/ot_hgi_dma_front_core.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/ot_hgi_dma_front_xs.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/ot_hgi_dma_front_xsw.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2.v rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/tb_hgi_dma_front.sv -j 4 > {RUN}/bench/build0.log 2>&1 && {RUN}/bench/obj0/Vtb_hgi_dma_front 2>&1 | tee {RUN}/bench/m0.log && grep -q 'PASS HGI_DMA_FRONT' {RUN}/bench/m0.log
